records.description: Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. records.name: Ottante
records.tagline: Checks the work your AI agents did, right on your Mac
records.description: Your AI says it's done, but is it right? When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini finish, Ottante compares the project with the model it came from and alerts you only about what's new. The check uses no AI. Stays on your Mac.

records.name: NEXUS
records.tagline: Map codebase locally and AI changes only what you approved
records.description: NEXUS is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that helps you understand a codebase before anything changes it. It indexes a folder locally and maps the architecture — modules, imports, dependency cycles, most-imported files — with no AI or account. Share a one-file report with no source code, benchmark local models on your own hardware, and let AI agents work in a separate Git worktree that changes your files only after you approve the plan, each command and the diff.

records.name: Kagi Mail
records.tagline: Private email that puts people who need you first
records.description: Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

records.name: Pax by Pydantic
records.tagline: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin
records.description: Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

records.name: Transept AI
records.tagline: Translate your book in your own voice and prove authorship
records.description: Since our first launch, Transept became a tool for writers translating their own books. New: you read the translation as a book, next to your original. Author mode reads your manuscript first and drafts the glossary, style guide and characters for you to approve. The Originality report records, word by word, what the AI wrote and what you changed. PDFs come back as the same pages. The Free plan translates your first page in full; paid plans from €9/$10 a month.

records.name: Flurra
records.tagline: Ask Claude or ChatGPT to edit your videos
records.description: Flurra is a video editor that Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can use for you. Connect it once (sign in, no API key), then describe the edit: cut the dead air, add bold hook text, put your logo top-right, cut yourself onto a new background, or match the style of a video you love. Claude edits your Flurra project, you preview every change and keep only what you like, then it renders the 1080p cut. Flurra also writes scripts in your voice and plans your posts. iPhone and web.

records.name: Watch Reader
records.tagline: Books and articles, read aloud on your Apple Watch
records.description: Add books, articles and web pages on your iPhone, then leave it at home. The AI voice runs on your Apple Watch itself, so it reads to you with no signal. Morning news, 25 voices, free classics. Free to download, with 30min free listening everyday forever.

records.name: Nookdeck
records.tagline: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer
records.description: Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: Remora
records.tagline: The long-term memory layer for AI agents
records.description: Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

records.name: ExtraOrbital
records.tagline: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents
records.description: Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

records.name: OpenChat
records.tagline: Open-source live chat in your own Cloudflare account
records.description: Customer chat for your website that runs in your own Cloudflare account, so conversations stay with you. A 2 KB widget in 11 languages, a team inbox on web, iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted notifications, a help centre, and an optional AI assistant that answers first and hands over to a person. Open source and self-hosted, with one-click deploy.

records.name: Chunkify
records.tagline: Video Streaming API for Developers & AI Agents
records.description: Chunkify is a video streaming platform for developers and AI agents. Your videos stay in your own S3 or R2 bucket and stream through your CDN, so you always own your data. One API covers the full pipeline: uploads, per-title adaptive encoding, HLS streaming, thumbnails, captions and playback analytics.

records.name: InfraThrone DevOps Park
records.tagline: Fix 300+ real production outages in live DevOps labs

Interview Bank: questions from 100+ companies, answered by experience level, each linked to an outage. Daily challenges, streaks and a leaderboard. Try it free.

records.name: WhipDesk

records.name: Meboki

Wavy underlines appear as you type in Mail, Slack, Notion, Gmail and most other apps; press Return to fix them all. Like Grammarly's grammar and spelling fixes, but offline: no account, no subscription, no telemetry. GPL-3.0 source. $39 once, 50% off each for 3+ licences; free hotkey mode after the 7-day trial. records.description: Black Friday Vault lists 180+ live Black Friday deals on SaaS, AI, developer and WordPress tools, with the regular price shown next to each deal price. Filter by lifetime, yearly or free, set free alerts by category and minimum discount, and upvote and save the deals worth buying. Free for buyers; makers can submit deals for free.

records.name: SMSWire
records.tagline: Your Android phones, as an SMS API
records.description: Pair an Android phone with a SIM and your app sends SMS through it with one POST. Login codes (OTP), a replies inbox, STOP opt-outs, backup phones and campaigns are built in. Your carrier's SMS rates apply; SMSWire is a flat plan, never per message, and the free plan covers 1,000 SMS a month. One SIM sends about 30 SMS parts a minute. The Android app is open source (GPL-3.0). SDKs for Node, Python, PHP/Laravel and Go, plus an MCP server for coding agents.

records.name: Geozy
records.tagline: Explore 5,000 years of borders and 141 stats on a 3D globe
records.description: Geozy is a free world atlas built on real data. Watch 5,000 years of borders on a 3D globe, explore 141 stats for every country, see how each leader really did, compare countries and play a daily geography quiz. Share any of it as a post. No sign-up.

records.name: opsandgo
records.tagline: Managed AWS hosting for React, Next.js and Node.js apps
records.description: We run your live React, Next.js or Node.js app in a new AWS account in your name. We deploy, back up, monitor and patch it for a fixed monthly fee from $490. You pay AWS directly, with no markup. Every deploy can roll back, and the production database gets a restore test every month. A portal shows app status, deploys, monthly AWS cost and secrets. No lock-in: if you leave, the account stays yours.

records.name: StackFocus
records.tagline: Macro focus stacking, entirely on your phone
records.description: StackFocus turns your iPhone or Android phone into a dedicated macro focus-stacking camera. One tap sweeps the lens through your subject and captures up to 28 frames; every frame is aligned against handheld drift and parallax, and the sharpest pixels are blended into one tack-sharp photo at full sensor resolution. Edit and export on the device. No cloud, no account, no subscription: free to try with three full-res exports, then a one-time $4.99.

records.name: MeetFolks
records.tagline: AI Notetaker for In-Person Meetings
records.description: MeetFolks turns in-person meetings into named transcripts, summaries, and action items. Everyone joins from their own phone or laptop, so each person is captured close up by their own mic. Each device recognises its owner's voice, so you know who said what without labelling speakers yourself or buying a dedicated recorder.

records.name: Search for Agents by Cloudflare
records.tagline: One toggle makes your site searchable by AI agents
records.description: Flip one toggle in the Cloudflare dashboard and your site becomes searchable by AI agents. Cloudflare creates an AI Search index for your zone, crawls your content and adds agent meta tags that point to a search endpoint on your own domain: /.well-known/search?q=. Agents get ranked Markdown excerpts instead of crawling page by page. Supports the new HTTP QUERY method, optional MCP and REST endpoints, and your existing WAF and bot rules. Free plan included, with limits.

records.name: TronSave
records.tagline: Rent TRON Energy to lower USDT transfer fees
records.description: Rent TRON Energy and Bandwidth to lower USDT transfer fees, through the website, Telegram bot or API. TRX holders can supply resources from staked TRX. Early Unstake lets eligible holders receive TRX before the normal unstaking wait, subject to funding and fees. It requires permanently transferring control of the staking wallet to TronSave; use a dedicated wallet and review the terms.

records.name: Deck
records.tagline: Sixteen native desktop widgets — now on Linux, too
records.description: Sixteen real desktop widgets for macOS and Linux — CPU, memory, disk, network, battery, git, ports, clipboard, weather, clocks, CI, Azure work items, calendar, pull requests, markets, logs and machines — plus a fast search panel. Native WidgetKit on macOS; native GTK4 on Linux with Wayland, X11, a signed apt repository, AppImage and Flatpak. Local-first, no account, no telemetry, no Deck server. Free and open source.

records.name: Follow-through
records.tagline: Never drop a follow-up. 99¢, no subscription, no account.
records.description: Follow-through turns the things you said you'd do into reminders that reach you. Type or dictate it the way you'd say it and it sets the time, or asks when it's unclear. Track who owes you a reply. iPhone and Apple Watch. No account, no tracking.

records.name: Kuku Map
records.tagline: Remember your route. Get woken before your stop.
records.description: Kuku Map is a free GPS app with two superpowers. Trail Back remembers the route you walked, rode or drove and guides you safely back the same way. Arrival Alert wakes you with an alarm before your stop, even with the screen locked, so you never miss it on the bus or train. Works on the web and as an Android app, in English + 11 languages, with offline maps.

records.name: Pixelify
records.tagline: AI Image Editing. Private, Free, and Right in Your Browser.
records.description: Pixelify is a free, on-device AI photo editor. Upscale images up to 8x with Vitality, Pixel-Dance and Alpha-Satoru, and remove backgrounds instantly with Chopper. Everything runs in your browser on WebGPU and WASM, so your photos never leave your device. No uploads, no sign-up, no tracking.

records.name: LineFerry
records.tagline: Use your old Android's SIM for calls and SMS on iPhone
records.description: Put your SIM in a spare Android phone and get its calls and texts on your iPhone, from your own number. LineFerry forwards calls and texts from a SIM in an old Android phone to your iPhone. Keep your home number abroad, or use a second line on an iPhone with no free SIM slot. Pick how calls ring: Android, iPhone, both, or iPhone first.

records.name: CYBERLAB X
records.tagline: Think Like a Hacker. Defend Like a Pro.
records.description: CYBERLAB X is a browser-based cybersecurity learning platform featuring password analysis, AES-GCM encryption, URL safety checks, simulated terminal environments, network simulations, and interactive cybersecurity education. Explore digital security concepts through practical tools designed for students, developers, and aspiring ethical hackers.

records.name: crewrota
records.tagline: Separate Claude Code logins for work and your own projects
records.description: crewrota is a free, open source CLI for people with more than one Claude Code login, such as one for work and one for their own projects. Each login lives in its own folder and stays signed in, so they run side by side. Logins on the same ship share history, so a session started on one resumes on another. crew quota shows every login's 5-hour and weekly usage. Your skills, plugins and CLAUDE.md come along. MIT licence. Windows is the main platform; macOS and Linux are beta.

records.name: VelyTools
records.tagline: 120 free browser-based tools with zero tracking
records.description: VelyTools is a private, lightning-fast suite of 120 free tools across text manipulation, developer utilities, calculators, productivity, and SEO. Everything processes 100% locally in your browser—no file uploads to servers, no accounts or sign-ups, and zero tracking. Clean UI with dark mode support built for everyday workflows.

records.name: BuddhaWish
records.tagline: A quiet space for wishes, reflection and daily practice
records.description: An AI-driven space for inner growth. Start with a daily AI reading, write a private wish, and take one small step with journaling, meditation and cross-tradition wisdom. A companion, not an oracle — tend to your inner life.

records.name: Dorameow
records.tagline: Discover 2,400+ curated open-source GitHub projects
records.description: Dorameow is a fast, bilingual (EN/ZH) directory of 2,400+ curated open-source GitHub projects across 78 categories. Browse by stars, licenses, and recent updates to discover open-source alternatives to popular tools, plus daily AI & dev news.

records.name: Listbia
records.tagline: Company Intelligence & Discovery Platform
records.description: Listbia is a company intelligence and discovery platform built to make it easier to explore the companies, people, and stories shaping industries around the world.

records.name: Webdesly Horology
records.tagline: Purchase, valuation and service for watch collectors
records.description: Quiet collector vault for watch portfolios: purchase versus valuation P/L, service due, and a Today board to mark service done. Not a marketplace, not an authenticity lab. Free Collector Demo, no signup.

records.name: OddForge TenderMaster ELITE
records.tagline: Prepare smarter construction bids and tender packs
records.description: TenderMaster ELITE is an offline tender-preparation toolkit for builders and estimators. Build priced bills of quantities, compare supplier quotations, plan labour and material costs, model contingency and profit margins, and document tender risks. Export client-ready HTML tender packs, CSV BOQs and JSON project backups. Modern desktop browser, one-time £249 purchase. Review all figures before submitting a real bid.

records.name: DICE LINKED
records.tagline: Multiplayer dice roller for RPGs: same throw on every screen
records.description: DICE LINKED is a multiplayer dice roller for tabletop RPGs, dungeon crawls and game night. Create a room, share the six-letter code, link or QR, and every d20 throw plays out the same on every screen, in person or remote. D4 to D100, Fate dice, exploding dice and saved presets, with real bounce, sound and shake-to-roll. No account needed. Free on iOS and Android, with optional dice skins, boards and Plus. In 42 languages.

records.name: WhyDip
records.tagline: know every move!
records.description: Stock charts show a sharp jump or drop without telling you what caused it, so you have to match dates across filings and articles. WhyDip splits NSE and BSE charts into price swings and maps each move to cited sources. Look up any stock on whydip.in or view catalysts next to Groww charts with the Chrome extension. WhyDip is completely free to use.

records.name: Leaf
records.tagline: the open document format to replace PDF
records.description: Leaf is a free, open-source document format built to replace PDF. Open a Leaf file or a PDF in your browser, edit the text, fill forms, sign, and save it back as a Leaf or a PDF. No account needed. The spec is CC BY 4.0, the core is Apache 2.0, and the editor is AGPL-3.0.

records.name: America Unfolded
records.tagline: Explore American history through maps.
records.description: A free interactive atlas of U.S. territorial history, 1776–1959. Explore sourced boundary snapshots, compare changes, and follow a guided story. Save maps as PNGs or embed a dated view on your site. No account required.

records.name: Roleora
records.tagline: Log your work. Get a resume and interview practice from it
records.description: Log your work in English or Hinglish. Roleora turns it into a resume where every bullet links back to the entry it came from, and Meera, an AI interviewer, asks you about it by voice. Private until you choose. For students and working professionals.

records.name: Canard Form
records.tagline: Form builder and form backend, hosted in France
records.description: Build forms without code or connect existing HTML forms without managing a backend. Canard Form is an independent French alternative to Google Forms, Typeform, Tally, Formspree and Web3Forms. Manage submissions in a collaborative inbox with real-time updates, spam protection and antivirus scanning. Includes API, JavaScript SDK, webhooks and MCP integration. Data hosted in France on Scaleway. Free for up to 100 submissions per month, no credit card required.

records.name: OpenAngels
records.tagline: Find & pitch 11,700+ verified angels with AI & CRM
records.description: Find active pre-seed & seed investors, draft zero-hallucination cold pitches, and track your raise in one workspace. Filter 11,700+ verified angels & seed VCs by sector, stage, location, check size, and backed deals across 140+ hubs. Generate thesis-aligned cold emails tailored strictly to your real traction, track conversations in a Kanban CRM, and scan 100 SEC-audited breakout startups on Venture Radar. Try top angels & 10 AI pitches/hr free — or unlock lifetime access for $49.

records.name: SaaSitude
records.tagline: Laravel SaaS boilerplate with billing, teams and admin done
records.description: Laravel 13 SaaS boilerplate: Stripe, Paddle and SSLCommerz billing behind one interface, workspaces, entitlements, admin console, mobile API and a 5-step web installer. Production-hardened, 182 tests, MIT.

records.name: Postia
records.tagline: Social Media Scheduling & Cross-Posting
records.description: Write a post once and Postia publishes it to Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, WordPress and more. Calendar, queue, per-network previews and analytics. Free plan, every network on every plan. Web, iOS and Android.

records.name: willFlock
records.tagline: Find a time for any group, in every time zone
records.description: Share one link and everyone taps when they're free, each in their own time zone. You see the times that work for the most people. It works even when people can't share calendars: different companies, work and personal accounts, or no calendar at all. Find a time for a group, let people book 1:1 slots, or vote on the best day. No sign-up for you or your guests. Free.

records.name: PlanWise
records.tagline: Plan, score, schedule and track YouTube, IG & TikTok with AI
records.description: Still planning content in a spreadsheet? PlanWise is a content planner for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok creators. • One board from Idea to Publish, with calendar and list views • AI writes the hook, caption and hashtags, then scores the post before it goes live • Seven formats, from Shorts to carousels • Per-post analytics and 100+ metrics, with AI Insights on what to post next Free 14-day trial, no credit card. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off their first payment.

records.name: Pulse Dialer
records.tagline: Multi-Line Power Dialer for Startups & Small Teams
records.description: Make up to 3 calls at once and connect with the first person who answers. Pulse automatically calls back the other answered contacts after you finish and log the first call’s outcome. Built for startups and small sales teams at $19.99/month per user. Bring your own Twilio account with no usage markup. Try it free for 7 days. No credit card required.

records.name: Code the Robot
records.tagline: Program a tiny flying robot: a 3D coding puzzle game
records.description: Snap instructions together, tap Run and watch a little robot fly. Six worlds and 48 levels bring in arrows, loops, functions, sensors and altitude. Three stars for the shortest program, a daily level, step mode. Free, offline, no account, 7 languages.

records.name: EuropeAI Radar
records.tagline: Silicon Valley gets the headlines. Europe gets this app.
records.description: EuropeAI Radar is a free iPhone app that follows Europe's AI story. Every morning it reads the press of 30+ European countries in their own languages, keeps the AI news that matters for Europe and summarises each story in a short English card, linked to its source. Once a week, the Weekly Europe Stand explains where Europe stands in AI in five minutes. Plus in-person AI events in 22 cities. No account, no ads. AI-written, human-reviewed.

records.name: Outrun GEO Checker
records.tagline: Is your site ready for AI search? Free, no email, instant
records.description: Paste a URL and see your A–F grade with every recommendation in seconds. 100% free: no email address, no signup, no meeting or sales call to get your results. • 186 checks across 42 categories: AI crawler access, structured data, llms.txt, meta and social tags, images, security • Every check explains the problem, why it matters and how to fix it, with its primary source • Export a PDF, share a link, or download an AI brief for Claude Code or Cursor • 11 languages

records.name: TelegramAI-Trader
records.tagline: Smarter Crypto Trading Insights, Right on Telegram
records.description: AI-Trader AI-Trader is a Telegram Mini App designed to help cryptocurrency traders access market analysis and AI-assisted trading insights in one convenient place. Key Features - Cryptocurrency market analysis - AI-assisted trading signals and insights - Trading and account management tools - TRON (TRC20) wallet connectivity - Easy access directly through Telegram Get Started Open AI-Trader on Telegram: https://t.me/MajidAlterater_bot

records.name: Utilvance QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Free QR codes for links, text and maps. No sign up.
records.description: Create QR codes for website links, plain text and Google Maps locations. Download a high resolution image that stays sharp in print. Codes are static and never expire. No account, no email, no subscription. Built by Sohaib Younas at utilvance.com.

records.name: Good Morning Gorgeous
records.tagline: Your personal AI encouragement companion for women
records.description: Meet Grace, your AI companion for daily encouragement, meaningful conversations, journaling and personal growth. Choose faith-based, balanced or nonreligious support tailored to your preferences. Try your first three messages free, then continue for $9.99/month. Designed for women who want to make encouragement and self-care part of their everyday routine.

records.name: JSON Studio
records.tagline: Paste JSON, Python dicts or log lines. See them clearly.
records.description: View, format, query and compare JSON, Python dicts and other dict-like data. Unwraps stringified JSON, Base64 and JWTs, keeps big numbers exact, and runs 100% in your browser. Free, open source, no tracking.

records.name: LayerSVG
records.tagline: Convert any image into a clean, layered SVG in seconds
records.description: LayerSVG turns PNG, JPG and other raster images into layered, editable SVG vector files right in your browser. No install, no account needed — upload an image, pick your settings, and download a clean SVG with separated layers you can edit in any design tool. Free to use, runs entirely client-side.

records.name: Arty
records.tagline: White-Label SMM Panel Software
records.description: Arty is SMM panel software you rent, not build. Get a fully hosted panel on your own domain with API v2, providers and payments built in. 17 customer themes, 90+ payment gateways (crypto, cards, local wallets), child panel sales, automations, refills, drip-feed, subscriptions, affiliates and tickets. Free migration from your current panel. From $25 a month, up to 50% cheaper.

records.name: Minipiry
records.tagline: Never let food expire unnoticed again
records.description: Minipiry is a free iPhone app that tracks expiry dates for food, medicine and personal care. Add by voice — say "Milk expires in three days" — pick when to be reminded, get one notification a day, and sync to your calendar. No sign-up, no data collected.

records.name: Utilvance Image Size Reducer
records.tagline: Reduce image file size online. Free, no sign up.
records.description: Reduce the file size of your photos and images online. Upload an image, shrink it and download the smaller file. No account, no email, no subscription. Built by Sohaib Younas at utilvance.com.

records.name: AItoExcel
records.tagline: Convert table screenshots and PDFs into editable Excel
records.description: Turn table screenshots, photos, and PDFs into editable Excel spreadsheets. Upload a file, pick the PDF pages you need, review the extracted rows and columns, then download an XLSX. Built for anyone who routinely retypes reports, invoices, or scanned tables. Try one image or PDF page free.

records.name: Idle Studio: Photo Tycoon
records.tagline: Grow a photo studio from passport photos to astrophotography
records.description: Idle Studio is an idle tycoon about building a photography career. Start with passport photos and work up through pet portraits, weddings, fashion and concerts to astrophotography. Each station is a polaroid that develops while the shoot runs. Hire 12 managers so the studio earns while you're away, buy 27 pieces of gear and open studios in 14 cities. Golden Hour doubles income at your real local sunrise and sunset. Free, no ads.

records.name: Jouli
records.tagline: Solar proposals and CRM, from an address to a signed job
records.description: Proposal, pricing and CRM software for Australian solar, battery, hot water and air-con installers. Certificates and state incentives worked out line by line, online signing, and a CRM included. Pay per proposal from $4 + GST, no subscription.

records.name: Aika
records.tagline: Now with a globe clock, focus timer & plain-English events
records.description: Aika is a calendar in your Mac menu bar, rebuilt for macOS Tahoe. New since the first launch: a world clock on a real globe with live day and night, a focus timer that pauses before meetings, events typed in plain English, an hour-by-hour day view, and six themes. Still one-click joins for Zoom, Meet and Teams, and a full-screen alert when a call starts. Pay once. No account. Nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: DairyPilot
records.tagline: Modular ERP for dairy manufacturers
records.description: Modular ERP for dairy manufacturers: batch-tracked inventory, production with yield and variance tracking, challan-to-invoice sales, double-entry finance and payroll — twelve modules in Bangla and English, self-hosted on plain PHP and MySQL.

records.name: What You Should Never Lose
records.tagline: Protect Your Dreams, Focus, Health, Time & Self-Respect
records.description: A practical guide to protecting what makes life meaningful: your dreams, focus, health, self-respect, and time. Learn to regain direction, build better habits, and focus on what truly matters. Get the ebook for $7.99: https://payhip.com/b/NxgV8

records.name: Klarviz
records.tagline: Describe a chart in plain English. Get it instantly.
records.description: Upload a CSV or spreadsheet, describe the chart you want in plain English, get a rendered result. No code, no chart wizards. Just: "Bar chart of monthly revenue by product line, sorted highest to lowest" — done. The LLM receives your column schema, outputs a Vega-Lite spec, validated and rendered in the browser. Iterate with follow-up instructions. Supports bar, line, scatter, pie, heatmap, and more. Export as PNG, SVG, or Vega-Lite spec. Free: 10 charts/month. €19/month unlimited.

records.name: WrenchNear
records.tagline: Find Trusted Mobile Mechanics Near You
records.description: Find, compare and contact mobile mechanics across the US who come to your home, workplace or roadside. Browse their services, check verification details and read customer reviews, so you can pick a mechanic you trust without a trip to the shop.

records.name: Bonfire of Wishes
records.tagline: Write a wish, we burn it
records.description: Write a wish, send it and watch it burn in a bonfire. The animation plays on your phone, and pending wishes are printed and burned for real. No account or login needed. Free, supported by ads. Available in 8 languages for iOS and Android.

records.name: Yomikaze
records.tagline: Open-source manga reader for Windows and iOS
records.description: Yomikaze is a free, open-source manga reader for iPhone, iPad and Windows. Browse and search the WeebCentral catalog, read in vertical (webtoon) or paged mode with two pages side by side, download chapters for offline reading, and keep your library, progress and favourites in sync with AniList. Everything stays on your device: no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Construction Safety Tracker
records.tagline: Inspect sites. Track hazards. Close safety actions.
records.description: An Excel-based construction safety toolkit for contractors and site supervisors. Conduct daily site inspections, identify and assess hazards, assign corrective actions, record incidents and near misses, and monitor safety performance through interactive dashboards. Includes OSHA-aligned checklists, hazard tracking, corrective-action monitoring, incident logs, and printable inspection tools—all in one practical workbook.

records.name: Recoon Verifier
records.tagline: Free Email Verifier & Bulk Email Checker
records.description: Free email verifier and bulk email checker. Detect invalid, catch-all, disposable and role-based emails. Clean email lists, find business contacts, audit domains, and automate verification with API and AI integrations. Get 100 free signup credits and 25 daily free checks. Built by Saffat IT.
